mutations.label: IX1 the record carries an empty list instead of the rounds, so the verdict says nothing about what the loop saw -- the defect the ticket is named for

IX2 REACHABILITY: the loop bound goes to zero, so the append is byte-identical in the source and never executes -- an AST assertion that the append sits inside a for loop cannot see this (the #1203pi / quoted-statement family)
IX3 the list is reassigned rather than appended, so only the final round survives and a form that reveals its password on round two is indistinguishable from one that never advanced
